scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@boltbytes/contracts && npm run build --workspace=@boltbytes/api && npm run build --workspace=@boltbytes/worker && npm run build --workspace=@boltbytes/admin
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run start:dev --workspace=@boltbytes/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@boltbytes/admin" "npm run start:dev --workspace=@boltbytes/worker"
scripts.lint: eslint services/api/src services/api/test services/worker/src services/worker/test web/admin/src shared/contracts/src --ext .ts,.tsx
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@boltbytes/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace=@boltbytes/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@boltbytes/worker && npm run typecheck --workspace=@boltbytes/admin
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@boltbytes/api && npm run test --workspace=@boltbytes/worker && npm run test:release
scripts.ci: npm run version:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
